title: Direct Deposit Relief on Takeover-Card Liability — Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Rate Note
content:
**Rate note.** This note covers the Pocketwire Visa Debit Card. On a dispute of a purchase on a *takeover card*, a virtual card the cardholder says they never created, the deposit relief is read from the direct deposits into the linked Pocketwire Personal Account over the two months up to the filing date.

| Direct deposits into the linked Pocketwire Personal Account, two months up to the filing date | Deposit relief |
|---|---|
| at least 2000.00 | 0.6 |
| at least 300.00, but less than 2000.00 | 0.8 |
| less than 300.00 | 1 |

The 300.00 edge is the card tier's direct-deposit threshold, which is 300.00 on every tier.

**Notes**

- Only direct deposits into the linked personal account count. Other money coming into that account does not.
- The deposits are totalled over the two months up to the filing date. They are read from the ledger of the Pocketwire Personal Account.

### Edges (hypothetical totals)

| Two-month direct deposit total | Deposit relief |
|---|---|
| 2000.00 | 0.6, because 2000.00 is at least 2000.00 |
| 1999.99 | 0.8 |
| 300.00 | 0.8, because 300.00 is at least 300.00 |
| 299.99 | 1 |
| 0.00, no direct deposits | 1 |

*Hypothetical.* Two paychecks of 1250.00 were deposited directly into the personal account within the two months up to the filing date. The total is 2500.00, which is at least 2000.00, so the deposit relief is 0.6.
